description: This file defines build configurations, device settings, and associated build commands for the SAMA7G5-EK development board, including device-specific parameters, NAND storage options, and SD card image creation procedures.

methods.name: Device/default-nand
methods.description: Defines NAND storage parameters such as block size, page size, and MKUBIFS options.

methods.name: Build/at91-sdcard
methods.description: Build target for creating an SD card image with multiple steps including formatting, copying files, setting environment variables, and packaging the image.

methods.name: Device/microchip_sama7g5-ek
methods.description: Defines device-specific parameters such as vendor, model, device tree source, supported devices, and kernel size/load address.
